title: Add GitHub CI and release workflows

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: ci.yml: push+PR, Python 3.11/3.12 matrix with uv, ruff check + format check, behave, pytest. release.yml: python-semantic-release on push to main with contents+id-token write; PyPI publish commented out.

right_now_summary: CI runs linting and tests on pushes and PRs, while releases are prepared on main without PyPI publishing.
